title: roster
description: The hub's roster subscription's net change since the cursor the subscriber last had — the sessions.subscribe reply's, or the previous roster notification's (plan 032 §3.6): rows added or changed (upserts) and the host ids of rows gone (removes); a host is in at most one of the two. Flushed at most every 250 ms. cursor only increases within an epoch, and may jump. Only the hub sends it.

removes.description: The host ids of the rows gone.
